item.description:
CHICKEN BIRYANI INGREDIENTS For the onions: -Red onions -Neutral oil or ghee For the biryani masala: (You can also buy it pre-made but fresh is amazing) -Coriander seeds -Cumin seeds -Green cardamom -Black cardamom -Cinnamon stick -Whole cloves -Black peppercorns -Fennel seeds -Bay leaf -Star anise -Nutmeg For the marinade: -Chicken thighs and drumsticks -Plain whole milk yogurt -Ginger -Garlic -Red chili powder (Kashmiri chili powder) -Ground turmeric -Salt -Fresh lemon juice -A splash of the reserved onion oil (from frying onions) Save the oil for later in the recipe! For the rice: -Basmati rice -Green cardamom -Black cardamom -Cinnamon stick -Whole cloves -Bay leaves -Salt For layering: -Saffron threads -Whole milk -Fresh cilantro -Fresh mint -Green chilies -Ghee -Reserved onion oil -Rose water (optional)
